user.title: Room Routines
user.description: Motion lights that follow your daily routine. This creates the five default periods (overnight, early morning, morning, day, evening). Add your rooms afterwards from the integration's settings.

error.invalid_room: A room needs at least one light and at least one sensor that can switch the lights on. A sensor can't have both roles in the same room.
error.invalid_periods: Every period needs a name of its own and a start time no other period uses on the same days.
error.last_period: There has to be at least one period.

add_room.title: Add a room
add_room.description: Choosing an area fills in its lights and sensors on the next screen as suggestions. You can change any of them.

room_details.title: {room}
room_details.description: A new room starts in log-only mode, with every light switching on at its last brightness in every period. Save looks per period later with the 'Save a room look' action.

data.holds: Sensors that only keep the lights on
data.timeout_s: Switch off after the room is empty for
data.cooldown_s: After lights are switched off by hand, ignore motion for

data_description.lights: The lights this room switches on and off.
data_description.triggers: Any motion or presence sensor. When one of these sees someone and the room is dark enough, the lights come on.
data_description.holds: Optional. These never switch the lights on, but keep them on while they see someone. Useful for a sensor that sometimes reports people who aren't there.
data_description.lux_sensor: Optional. The room's own light level, only read while the room's lights are off.
data_description.threshold_lux: Leave empty to switch on at any light level.
data_description.fade_out_s: How long the lights take to go out at the end. 10 to 20 seconds is gentle enough not to notice from the corner of your eye; 0 switches straight off.
data_description.drift_s: Only for a room that is lit when the period changes.
data_description.self_fading: Optional. For lights whose own device fades them, such as a DALI gateway set to dim to off over a few seconds. These get a plain on or off and do their own fade. Lights that Home Assistant can fade are faded anyway; any others fade in small steps.

period_times.title: Start times
period_times.description: Each period starts at its time and runs until the next one starts. Pick days that use different times, then give those times; any left empty keep the normal time.

add_period.title: Add a period
add_period.description: Rooms use the previous period's look in a new period until you save one for it.

data.name: Name
data.alt_start: Starts at, on the days with different times

edit_period.title: {period}
edit_period.description: Removing a period removes the rooms' looks for it; they then use the previous period's.

data.name: Name
data.alt_start: Starts at, on the days with different times

set_look.name: Save a room look
set_look.description: Saves what a room's lights should do in a period, on Normal days or Dark Days.

period.name: Period
period.description: Leave empty for the current period.

look.name: Look
look.description: 'current' saves the room's lights as they are now; 'scene' turns on the scene below; 'nothing' keeps the room dark in this period; 'borrow' removes the period's own look (on Normal it uses the previous period's, on a Dark Day its Normal look).

track.name: Track
track.description: Normal (default) or dim (the Dark Day look).

scene.name: Scene
scene.description: The scene to turn on, for look 'scene'.

switch_on.name: Start a room's routine
switch_on.description: Switches the room's lights on to the current period's look and keeps them following the day (its own times, blending) until they are switched off. For a wall button.

entity_id.name: Room
entity_id.description: The room's status sensor (one or more).

switch_off.name: Switch a room's lights off
switch_off.description: Switches the room's lights off, however they were switched on.
